context:
Goal: a round-3 FAIL holds the change until its finding is fixed (your 356 a).
Problem (rule): a round-3 PARTIAL, where some findings stay open but the verdict is not FAIL, is not covered. The lane builds b meanwhile, and a change is a small toggle.
Based on (ruling): item 356 a, 2026-11-07 13:41 CST: "holds the change until the finding is fixed". Asked again because 356 named only a FAIL.
Departs from: main, where round 3 counts any verdict as done. The branch holds a FAIL only, and b adds a PARTIAL.

options.label: A PARTIAL keeps the old round-3 rules
options.lose: A change with an open finding can merge.

reply: b, 14:41 CST: a round-3 PARTIAL holds too. Relayed to lane review-fix-check-round (PR #1440); this closes on its done report.
